title: Lonnie Zamora never the same after Socorro

tellings.quote: you know, Sakor, New Mexico. I remember the wife of Lonnie Zamora looking at me and she goes, "I don't know what happened when he looked at that creature, but he was never the same."

plain: The wife of Lonnie Zamora, the police officer who reported an encounter at Socorro, New Mexico, in 1964, is said to have told the documentary filmmaker James Fox: "I don't know what happened when he looked at that creature, but he was never the same." Fox recalls her saying this to him in person, and he tells it to show that whatever Zamora saw changed him for good.
